Retained detached dialog nodes may depend on current focus/back references and GC; listener counts alone do not prove retained heap
shared_boundaries: Five loaded source image objects and atlasData/frame caches are reused within a document; actor meshes have distinct Three.Texture wrappers
Three module/core caches are per JavaScript realm; test wrapper adds one alias import for original module, does not add production assets
GPU counter reads use renderer.info.memory and native API create/delete only, not complete driver memory

vendor_context_fallback_texture_evidence.meaning: Native WebGL state creates fallback1x1 texture targets2D/cube/2D_ARRAY/3D; final API-live counts must be compared with these context-owned allocations, not silently ignored as leaked or proven released.

framebuffer_boundary: Observed3 native framebuffer handles remain after renderer.dispose, with no delete observed. Source candidates retained; actual driver/context reclamation not proved.
